visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Only the First Listener Is Notified
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Both Alice and Bob subscribed, but only Alice gets the price update.

solution.explanation: The point of the pattern is that the subject notifies every subscriber. Calling only the first element of the list leaves all the others without updates.

tests.pattern: (?<![\s\S])\s*Alice sees ACME at 120[ \t]*\r?\nBob sees ACME at 120\s*(?![\s\S])
